# Booth video

Animated intro (intro/intro.html) plus a headless recording of our web app (record/demo.mjs), assembled into booth_loop.mp4. Each render currently records the whole demo in one pass (about 20 minutes).

write what I should say while the booth video plays, I'll talk over it

files.video/DESIGN.md:
# Booth video

| Shot | Length | Content | Caption |
|---|---|---|---|
| A1 Title | 6 s | Title, authors, logos | none |
| A2 Problem | 11 s | LLM misjudges the distance between two wells | LLMs infer spatial relations unreliably from coordinates |
| A3 Method | 22 s | The DGGS grid and cell IDs | The DGGS grounds spatial relations in cell IDs |
| B Demo | 130 s | The web app replays methane plumes and agents attribute them | Each plume is routed to the grid agent that contains it |
